# θeta ai (Theta AI)

> EU AI Act compliance and AI security consulting for small and mid-sized businesses, based in Greece. θeta ai checks what a business signed with its AI vendors, what the EU AI Act requires of it, and how to harden its AI systems: mapping, gap analysis and monitoring. Founded by Maria Bartzoka (Μαρία Μπαρτζώκα), AI security and EU AI Act consultant. The name is written with a Greek theta: θeta ai; in Latin script, Theta AI.

Site languages: Greek (default, https://thetaai.gr/) and English (https://thetaai.gr/en/). Contact: hello@thetaai.gr. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/%CE%B8eta-ai/ (company), https://www.linkedin.com/in/mariabartzoka/ (founder).

## Services

- [θeta ai home (EN)](https://thetaai.gr/en/): EU AI Act compliance and AI security services for SMBs
- [θeta ai home (EL)](https://thetaai.gr/): the same in Greek

## AI Security Radar (updated daily)

Daily, source-verified briefing on the EU AI Act, AI security incidents and standards (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST). Every story has its own page with its original sources.

- [AI Security Radar (EN)](https://thetaai.gr/en/radar/): latest stories
- [AI Security Radar archive (EN)](https://thetaai.gr/en/radar/archive/): every story by month
- [AI Security Radar (EL)](https://thetaai.gr/radar/) and [archive (EL)](https://thetaai.gr/radar/archive/)
